summary: Barton Premium is a Kentucky Blended whiskey produced in Bardstown, Kentucky by the Sazerac Company at its Barton 1792 Distillery. The note states it is sold in several bottle sizes, including glass pint, 750ml, and 1-liter bottles and plastic 1.75L bottles.
one_line: Barton Premium is a Kentucky blended whiskey made by the Sazerac Company at its Barton 1792 Distillery in Bardstown, Kentucky.
